english.title: Scrap metal dealer make payment for scrap metal other than by cheque / electronic transfer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a scrap metal dealer, paid **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) for scrap metal, other than by a cheque which was not transferable, or by an electronic transfer of funds
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 12(1), (4) and (6) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: (i) It is a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that they made arrangements to ensure that payments complied with requirements and took all reasonable steps to ensure that those arrangements were complied with.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant being a scrap metal dealer, paid **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) for scrap metal, other than by a cheque which was not transferable, or by an electronic transfer of funds

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
